# Vulcan 工程历程

[English primary](JOURNEY.md) | [中文对照版本](JOURNEY.zh-CN.md)

两种视图来自同一份事件记录；生成的任务、诊断和交接保留原语言。

同一角色的连续工作归为一段；工具执行归入 Verifier，并行只读对话不算工程交接。

这是里程碑与工具边界记录，不是逐字推理直播，也不单独证明设计正确。

新后端工具流位于 .vulcan/runtime/agent_io.jsonl；历史记录保留原位置。

**最新事件:** 1393

**收到的任务（原文）:**
> Implement BELLOWS-L3: third-generation BELLOWS streaming compression subsystem:
> preserve BELLOWS-L1/L2 LZ4 compression and decompression, and add 4-Channel Interleaved
> Context Scheduling, Hardware XXH32/CRC32 Frame Content Checksum Generation & Verification,
> and Descriptor-Driven Scatter-Gather Streaming DMA framing. Verify multi-channel
> interleaved compression/decompression, corrupted-checksum detection (`err_checksum_mismatch`),
> backpressure, and bit-exact lossless round-trip against an independent Python reference.
> Top: bellows_l3_top.
> Use the native Coordinator, Designer, independent Verifier and Reviewer pipeline.
> Freeze numerical rules, interfaces, legal parameters and coverage thresholds before
> implementation; repair failures without weakening the admitted contract or replacing
> real execution with claimed results. Keep failing receipts and independent review.
> Deliver modular synthesizable rtl/*.sv, design/SPEC.md, design/ARCHITECTURE.md,
> tests/verify.py and the independently approved product PDF. Use portable project-
> relative reproduction commands and paths in all shipped files; never ship credentials,
> account directories, runtime transcripts or private host paths.
> All RTL must target the 100 MHz+ (<= 10.0 ns clock period) synchronous pipelined
> timing baseline on Intel Arria 10 GX (10AX115N2F45E1SG): zero combinational '/' or '%'
> operators, zero mixed blocking/non-blocking assignments in sequential blocks, and
> bounded logic depth between pipeline registers (with Coordinator timing-waiver fallback
> only if proven by post-synthesis Quartus STA).
> In tests/verify.py, execute portable L1 verification: real Icarus/Verilator behavior
> checks, independent numerical or cryptographic reference comparisons, deliberately
> injected defect-sensitivity cases, and Yosys synthesis/
> [Summary shortened; inspect the linked original record.]

**交接摘要（原文）:**
> The inspected parent is a byte-stream raw LZ4 compressor/decompressor with synchronous history storage, valid/ready backpressure and explicit completion errors. Four replicated parent contexts are the simplest reliable way to preserve that behavior while providing genuine interleaved channel progress; a globally serialized whole-frame wrapper would not satisfy the scheduling objective. no_operator_assumption: descriptor-framed raw blocks plus explicitly selected content trailers resolve unspecified framing without falsely claiming standard LZ4 Frame compatibility. no_operator_assumption: ordered byte DMA with one outstanding transaction per direction resolves the unspecified memory interface while retaining real scatter/gather addressing, acknowledged writes and physical-bridge integration. no_operator_assumption: canonical seed-zero XXH32, ISO-HDLC CRC32, fixed four channels, bounded configurable block/descriptor capacities and explicit first-error semantics freeze numerical and protocol ambiguity before implementation. Registered ownership and payload boundaries make reset, stalls and response association independently observable. The matrix includes endpoint and non-power-of-two cases without requiring impractical exhaustive simulation. Published checksum vectors, Python decoding, independently generated blocks, guard-memory checks and executed mutants prevent a self-consistent RTL/model pair from masquerading as correctness. If the captured request's channel then receives an error on the opposite DMA direction, bellows_l3_context.sv:310 stops further lane reservations but does not cancel the captured request. Once the other channel's outstanding response retires, DMA presents the failed channel's request for the first time. This violates the admitted requirement to cease new transactions after a processing failure. Preserving an already publicly presented, stalled request is necessary; treating every internal reservation as noncancelable, as ARCHITECTURE.md currently does, is broader than that requirement.
> 
> Add one public-pin regression, hidden-reservation-error-settlement, to the existing matrix command: delay one channel's response, allow another decoding channel to queue work in that direction, and inject an error into the latter channel's opposite-direction response. Assert that no previously unpresented request from the failed channel subsequently appears, while already presented requests remain stable and accepted transactions settle. Cover the read/write mirror, completion counts, exactly one error completion, unaffected-channel progress and same-channel reuse. Retain the failing result, then repair reservation admission or cancellation without withdrawing publicly stalled valid requests, and update the architectural explanation. Have the shared runtime rerun affected admitted checks without c
